Every month landlords squint at bank statements to see who paid. Landlord Ledger does it: matches rent to each tenant, flags late or short payments, sorts expenses for tax time, and drafts reminders you approve. It never moves money. https://t.co/o94eUKLlSn https://t.co/KyvFgn0Sus
